layout_hierarchy: 2. Hero card (.order-success-hero-compact): Checkmark + 'Order Placed!' + status subtext
3. Order Details card (.order-success-card-compact): Order #ID, total, Room/Table info
4. Items Ordered card (.order-success-items-card): Collapsible, default expanded
5. Transferred Orders card (.order-success-transferred-card): Collapsible, default COLLAPSED, positioned immediately BEFORE Bill Summary

6. Bill Summary card (.order-success-bill-card): Collapsible, contains item total, discount, service charge, subtotal, GST rows, Transferred Total row (if > 0), and Grand Total (current + transferred, APS-aware)
7. Order Status Tracker (.order-status-tracker-compact): Compact horizontal step dots
8. Action Buttons (.order-success-actions-compact): Edit Order / Browse Menu / Call Waiter / Pay Bill

transferred_orders_collapsible_card.position: Immediately AFTER Items Ordered card and immediately BEFORE Bill Summary card

header_elements.left: Transfer icon (e.g. MdOutlineSwapHoriz from react-icons/md) + 'Transferred Orders ({associatedOrders.length})'
header_elements.right: Total sum formatted: ₹{transferredTotal.toFixed(0)} + Chevron icon (IoChevronUpOutline when expanded, IoChevronDownOutline when collapsed)

bill_summary_transferred_total_row.position: Placed AFTER the last tax row (CGST, SGST, VAT, SC-CGST, SC-SGST) and immediately BEFORE the Grand Total row (.bill-row-total)
bill_summary_transferred_total_row.label: Transferred Total

grand_total_calculation.aps_masking_rule: When liveHasAPS is true: if effectiveGrandTotal > 0 then '₹' + effectiveGrandTotal.toFixed(2) + ' + APS' else 'APS'. When liveHasAPS is false: '₹' + effectiveGrandTotal.toFixed(2)

exact_css_rules: .order-success-transferred-card { background: var(--bg-primary, #fff); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); overflow: hidden; }
.order-success-transferred-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 14px 16px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background 0.2s; }

.order-success-transferred-title { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.order-success-transferred-total { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-primary, #E8531E); }
.order-success-transferred-toggle { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.order-success-transferred-content { padding: 0 16px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.order-success-transferred-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-light, #eee); }
.order-success-transferred-id { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); }
.order-success-transferred-amount { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In /app/frontend/src/pages/OrderSuccess.jsx, import MdOutlineSwapHoriz from 'react-icons/md' alongside existing icons.
2. Add state: const [showTransferredOrders, setShowTransferredOrders] = useState(false); (default is collapsed).
3. Compute transferredTotal: const transferredTotal = associatedOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (parseFloat(o.amount) || 0), 0);

4. Move the Transferred Orders card so it renders immediately before the Bill Summary card (between {isLoadingStatus || allItems.length > 0} card and {billSummary && ...} card). REMOVE the old flat card from below the Bill Summary.

5. Structure the Transferred Orders card header with: left icon <MdOutlineSwapHoriz />, title 'Transferred Orders ({associatedOrders.length})', right-aligned amount '₹{transferredTotal.toFixed(0)}', and toggle icon {showTransferredOrders ? <IoChevronUpOutline /> : <IoChevronDownOutline />} with data-testid='toggle-transferred-orders-btn'.
6. When showTransferredOrders is true, display the list of orders with #{o.restaurantOrderId} {dateStr} and ₹{(o.amount || 0).toFixed(0)}.

7. In Bill Summary card, right above
, add: {transferredTotal > 0 && (
Transferred Total₹{transferredTotal.toFixed(2)}
)}.

8. Update Grand Total in Bill Summary: calculate combinedTotal = (effBS.grandTotal || 0) + transferredTotal. Display as {liveHasAPS ? (combinedTotal > 0 ? `₹${combinedTotal.toFixed(2)} + APS` : 'APS') : `₹${combinedTotal.toFixed(2)}`}. Also update originalTotal bracket if active: billSummary.originalTotal + transferredTotal.

9. Update OrderSuccess.css to add styles for .order-success-transferred-card matching .order-success-bill-card spacing (padding: 14px 16px, 12px border-radius, clean dashed separators, flex layout). Ensure no duplicate margins breaking the 420px container flow.
10. Verify that when associatedOrders is empty or not provided, neither the Transferred Orders card nor the Transferred Total row appears, and Grand Total remains unchanged.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_tone: Clean, crisp, mobile-first POS ordering experience. Follows high-legibility typographic scale and 12px card border radius.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_surfaces: All cards must have solid bg (var(--bg-primary, #fff)) with 1px border or subtle ambient shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.05).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_attributes: Every interactive and dynamic element must have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.performance: No new external libraries; use existing react-icons and CSS module styling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.aps_compliance: Must maintain APS price masking format '₹X + APS' across all totals when liveHasAPS is true.
